protocol.shadowRegistry: Starts with frozen quotations only. Updated by neutral structural checks for allowed sources and existing parent references, never gold answers. All arms later replay the same plans.
protocol.bootstrap: Authored initial quotation fixture; no future concepts in the initial model or discovery prompt.
